headline: Last session: Sensex and Nifty closed lower as a global AI sell-off weighed on sentiment during Friday's trade.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 23 November.

why: A global sell-off in AI-related stocks impacted investor sentiment during the last trading session.
Record Foreign Institutional Investor (FII) buying has supported a broader four-week market rally.
The market is currently closed for the weekend and will resume operations on Monday.
Anticipation of a Free Trade Agreement between India and the EU is providing a positive long-term outlook.
whatHappening: Sensex fell approximately 250 points while Nifty 50 slipped below the 25,450 level in the previous session.
Diageo has been identified as India's largest liquor company by revenue for the year 2026.
ESIC has notified new rules under labour codes to simplify the benefit claims process for workers.
Global trends and FPI flows are expected to steer market direction in the upcoming holiday-shortened week.
summary: The Indian market is closed for the weekend following a session where indices retreated due to a global AI sector sell-off. Despite the recent dip, the market has maintained a four-week rally to nine-month highs driven by record FII buying. Investors are now looking toward the India-EU trade pact and global stabilization measures for future cues.
